components.name: Primary button
components.description: Standard clay action with a contact shadow and decorative ink outline; the upstream configuration CTA has its own yellow override.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button"><svg class="ds-primary-ink" viewBox="0 0 120 36" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M 7 2.2 Q 54 .6 113 2.6 Q 118.5 2 118 8 Q 119.6 18.72 117.5 30 Q 117 34.6 112 34 Q 62.4 35.7 7 33.5 Q 1.2 33 2 28 Q .6 16.2 2.5 7 Q 2.8 1.8 7 2.2 Z" fill="none" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" /></svg>保存更改</button>
components.css: .ds-primary { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:36px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:5px 8px 6px 9px / 8px 5px 9px 6px; font-family:var(--font-sans, "Kevin Sans", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:20px; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #2c4f9e); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #2c4f9e) 50%, transparent); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow:none; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition-duration:.01ms; } } @media (forced-colors:active) { .ds-primary { border:1px solid CanvasText; box-shadow:none; } } .ds-primary { background:var(--primary, #a84422); color:var(--primary-foreground, #fffdf6); box-shadow:0 2px 1px -1px rgb(58 44 30 / 15%); } .ds-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #a84422) 90%, transparent); } .ds-primary-ink { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; overflow:visible; stroke:var(--foreground, #2a2420); stroke-width:1.15px; }

components.css: .ds-outline { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:36px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:5px 8px 6px 9px / 8px 5px 9px 6px; font-family:var(--font-sans, "Kevin Sans", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:20px; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #2c4f9e); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #2c4f9e) 50%, transparent); } .ds-outline:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow:none; } .ds-outline:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-outline { transition-duration:.01ms; } } @media (forced-colors:active) { .ds-outline { border:1px solid CanvasText; box-shadow:none; } } .ds-outline { background:var(--background, #f8f5ee); color:var(--foreground, #2a2420); box-shadow:0 2px 1px -1px rgb(58 44 30 / 15%); } .ds-outline:hover { background:var(--muted, #eee9df); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-outline { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--input, #8b8170) 30%, transparent); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-outline:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--input, #8b8170) 50%, transparent); } .ds-outline-ink { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; overflow:visible; stroke:var(--foreground, #2a2420); stroke-width:1.15px; }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Low-emphasis action without an ink outline or contact shadow.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Labeled popover-paper field with stronger ink stroke, keyboard focus and invalid/disabled states.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-search-field">搜索上游</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-search-field" type="search" placeholder="搜索账号、服务商或地址…" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; color:var(--foreground, #2a2420); font-family:var(--font-sans, "Kevin Sans", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif); font-size:12px; line-height:16px; } .ds-field { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-width:0; height:36px; padding:4px 10px; border:1px solid var(--input, #8e8375); border-radius:5px 8px 4px 7px; background:var(--popover, #fffdf6); color:var(--foreground, #2a2420); caret-color:var(--primary, #a84422); font-family:var(--font-sans, "Kevin Sans", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif); font-size:16px; line-height:24px; transition:color 150ms, border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-foreground, #60584f) 80%, transparent); } .ds-field:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:var(--input, #8e8375); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring, #2c4f9e); outline-offset:3px; border-color:var(--ring, #2c4f9e); } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:var(--destructive, #b43a28); } .ds-field:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; cursor:not-allowed; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--input, #8e8375) 50%, transparent); } @media (min-width:768px) { .ds-field { font-size:14px; line-height:20px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-field { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.css: .ds-nav { padding:8px; background:var(--sidebar, #e7ecdf); } .ds-nav-item { box-sizing:border-box; display:flex; align-items:center; width:100%; height:32px; gap:8px; padding:8px; border:0; border-radius:4px 9px 5px 7px; background:transparent; color:var(--sidebar-foreground, #2a2420); text-align:start; font-family:var(--font-sans, "Kevin Sans", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:20px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"], .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:active { background:var(--sidebar-accent, #f8dc4c); color:var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #2a2420); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sidebar-ring, #2c4f9e); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav-item:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; } .ds-nav-icon { flex:none; width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-nav-label { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }

narrative.northStar: Looseleaf — paper, ink and a working desk
narrative.overview:
The user-selected Looseleaf component-library language makes CPA-Helper a quiet working desk: warm paper, sage surroundings, readable ink and small yellow highlights. Slightly uneven outlines give controls a human character while the layout remains orderly and dense enough for daily administration. Retain the existing CPA-Helper logo.

Source data, quotas, permissions and missing-data truth take precedence over decoration. Keep labels, numbers and state explanations easy to compare. Dark mode is a warm-paper variant of the same workspace, with lighter ink and restrained highlights.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and sage surfaces with clear ink contrast.
Controlled irregular corners and lightweight SVG ink outlines.
Compact controls, calm tables and tabular numbers.
Explicit operational states in both Chinese and English.

rules.name: The State Label Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with a label or value. A missing quota stays unavailable; it must never become a reassuring full bar.

rules.name: The Paper Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep shadows shallow and structural; preserve readable boundaries in dark mode and forced-color mode. Forced-color mode supplies a system-color border and removes card/button shadows.

dos: **Do** reuse the Looseleaf variables, local font stack and existing logo.
**Do** preserve compact density, contained table scrolling and the upstream mobile row layout.
**Do** put source, quota window, permissions and missing-data explanations ahead of decoration.
**Do** keep focus, invalid, disabled and reduced-motion states visible and functional.
**Do** use irregular ink outlines where the existing button and card primitives supply them.
donts: **Don't** substitute a generic cool-blue or glass visual system for the chosen paper-and-ink world.
**Don't** turn missing quota or usage data into zero, a full meter or a forecast.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate health, selection or errors.
**Don't** let decoration obscure labels, values or actionable state explanations.
**Don't** treat fixture screenshots or preview snippets as evidence of live accounts, routing or quota results.
